Writing Functions
================

``` r
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
```

``` r
library(readxl)
```

## Functions!

Start small with Z scores.

``` r
x_vec = rnorm(n = 40, mean = 12, sd = 63)

(x_vec - mean(x_vec)) / sd(x_vec)
```

    ##  [1]  0.987760687 -0.830937615  0.597930047 -0.002531744  2.143160151
    ##  [6] -2.042924618  1.404658187 -0.932317582 -0.090892108 -0.511244848
    ## [11] -0.112157593  1.635514673  0.022082717 -0.071924451 -0.459493109
    ## [16]  0.952911319 -1.333590936  0.118435247 -0.937443753  2.462748178
    ## [21]  0.792205714 -0.823190934 -0.088614393 -0.528089538  0.502934473
    ## [26]  0.253291352  0.278303506 -0.331037095 -1.195423398 -0.503108286
    ## [31]  0.417986834 -0.599977670 -0.944349543  1.319649262 -0.002750328
    ## [36] -0.694392964 -2.019603382  0.362295928 -0.139804251  0.943931864

Let’s turn this into a function

``` r
z_scores = function(x) {
  
  if (!is.numeric(x)) {
    stop("Input x must be numeric")
  } else if (length(x) < 5) {
    stop("x should have 5 or more numbers")
  }
  
  z = (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
  
  return(z)
  
}
```

Does this actually work???

``` r
z_scores(x_vec)
```
